notes:
CRM notes: mid-market product analytics SaaS. Evaluating Hosted -> Dedicated. Trial showed promising engagement but cost sensitivity. Key ask: accurate Dedicated sizing & QPS forecast for exec buy-in.
- Trial usage snapshot: avg QPS 8, peak QPS 42 (short bursts), avg concurrency observed ~10 requests, peak concurrency 28.
- Endpoint split: chat 58%, embeddings 28%, reranking/other 14%.
- Token mix (trial sample): ~62% short prompts (<=40 tokens), 30% mid (100-300 tokens), 8% long (600-1200 tokens).
- Avg response latency on Hosted: 220ms (chat, 128-token responses) to 1.1s for long responses.
- Cost notes: high cost sensitivity on embeddings; want cache + prefix reuse to reduce token spend.
- Model preferences: open weights (Llama2-Chat / Mistral) for Dedicated; fallbacks to quantized 4-bit variants.
- "We need guaranteed P99 latency <350ms for UI flows" — Product lead quote.
- Legal/security highlights: must support SSO (SAML) + audit logs + optional KMS. Data residency preference: US only.
- Lead engineer: "If Dedicated shows 30% cost reduction vs Hosted for our workload we can commit to reserved capacity."
dedicated_capacity_requirements: Customer ask: production handling for 12M tokens/day initially, scaling 3x in 12 months. P0 latency target P99 <350ms for chat UI. Current Hosted-trial-derived forecasts: steady-state QPS 12, peak QPS 55, concurrency target 35. Token mix above -> estimate peak token throughput ~60k tokens/min. Recommendation (ballpark): start with 3x A10G-equivalent GPU nodes with autoscale headroom to 5 nodes for burst; or 2x A100-sim nodes (higher perf) if using larger models -> sizing depends on chosen model/quantization. Include KV cache and batching to reduce token spend 20-35%.
traffic_forecast_notes: 12-month forecast (customer-provided scenario): month0 (prod launch) daily tokens 12M; month3 18M; month6 28M; month12 36M. QPS baseline scales from 12 -> 35 (month12) with peak burst multipliers x4 during synchronous UI events. Embeddings growth projected slower (~1.6x year). Recommended reserve plan: reserved capacity for baseline QPS with burst credits. Cost sensitivity: target blended token cost reduction >=30% vs hosted trial to justify Reserved commitment.
po_care_plan: POC request: 72-hour Dedicated staging run. Objectives: validate P99 latency under synthetic UI traffic, confirm autoscale triggers, verify KV/prefix cache hit rates, measure token cost per 1M tokens. Success criteria: P99 <350ms (chat), embeddings throughput 200 QPS at <150ms median, observed cost reduction >=25% vs hosted baseline.
